title: 相位式計算全像~Phase-only computer-generated holography
focus: 傅立葉全像的取樣、Gerchberg–Saxton 迭代、相位量化、相機閉環校正與全像顯示的工程化~Sampling of Fourier holograms, Gerchberg–Saxton iteration, phase quantization, camera-in-the-loop calibration and engineering of holographic displays
summary: 以 1920×1080、8 µm 像素的相位型 SLM 與 300 mm 傅立葉透鏡為基準系統，說明重建面取樣與視窗大小的關係、Gerchberg–Saxton 演算法的收斂與計算成本、相位量化與像素包絡的效率損失，再以相機閉環校正、散斑與零階的誤差預算，以及近眼全像顯示的視角與眼盒限制，完成相位全像的設計到驗收流程。~Using a 1920×1080, 8 µm phase-only SLM with a 300 mm Fourier lens as the reference system, the course explains replay-plane sampling and window size, the convergence and compute cost of the Gerchberg–Saxton algorithm, efficiency losses from phase quantization and the pixel envelope, then camera-in-the-loop calibration, a speckle and zeroth-order error budget and the field-of-view and eyebox limits of near-eye holographic displays, completing the design-to-acceptance flow of phase-only holograms.

units.anchor: SLM 平面與傅立葉重建面~SLM plane and Fourier replay plane
units.title: 傅立葉全像的取樣與視窗~Sampling and window of Fourier holograms
units.mechanism: 相位型計算全像把目標影像的資訊編碼成 SLM 上每個像素的相位，放在透鏡前焦面後，後焦面的光場是 SLM 場的傅立葉轉換。離散取樣決定兩個尺度：SLM 的像素週期 p 決定重建視窗的總寬度 λf/p，SLM 的總寬度 Np 決定重建面的最小解析單元 λf/(Np)，兩者相除就是每軸 N 個可定址點。零階總在視窗中心，所以實際影像通常安排在偏離中心的區域，且視窗之外會出現週期重複的高階影像。~A phase-only computer-generated hologram encodes the target image into the phase of every SLM pixel; with the SLM in the front focal plane of a lens, the field in the back focal plane is the Fourier transform of the SLM field. Discrete sampling fixes two scales: the pixel pitch p sets the total replay-window width λf/p, and the full SLM width Np sets the smallest replay resolution cell λf/(Np), so their ratio gives N addressable points per axis. The zeroth order always sits at the window centre, so the useful image is usually placed off-centre, and periodic higher-order copies appear beyond the window.
units.model: λ = 532 nm、f = 300 mm、p = 8 µm、N = 1920：視窗寬 λf/p = 0.532×10⁻³×300/0.008 ≈ 19.95 mm；重建像元 λf/(Np) = 19.95/1920 ≈ 10.4 µm；距中心 2.5 mm 的點對應空間頻率 2.5/(λf) ≈ 15.7 mm⁻¹，即週期 64 µm = 8 個像素的光柵。~With λ = 532 nm, f = 300 mm, p = 8 µm and N = 1920: window width λf/p = 0.532×10⁻³×300/0.008 ≈ 19.95 mm; replay cell λf/(Np) = 19.95/1920 ≈ 10.4 µm; a point 2.5 mm off-centre corresponds to a spatial frequency of 2.5/(λf) ≈ 15.7 mm⁻¹, a grating of 64 µm period, i.e. 8 pixels.
units.verify: 載入已知週期 8、16、32 像素的線性相位光柵，用相機在重建面量亮點位置，應落在 2.5、1.25、0.625 mm；再載入全像的最外圍目標點，確認其位置不超過視窗半寬 9.98 mm 並觀察高階重複影像的位置。~Load linear phase gratings with periods of 8, 16 and 32 pixels and measure the spot positions on the replay plane with a camera; they should fall at 2.5, 1.25 and 0.625 mm. Then load a hologram whose outermost target point lies near the window half-width of 9.98 mm and observe where the higher-order copies appear.
units.failure: 把目標影像放在視窗正中央，零階亮點疊在影像中心並比影像亮數十倍，相機飽和且使用者誤以為演算法失敗；移到象限位置後影像才清楚。~Placing the target image at the window centre stacks the zeroth-order spot on top of it, tens of times brighter than the image; the camera saturates and the algorithm is blamed, until the image is moved into a quadrant.
units.misconception: 重建影像的尺寸只由目標影像的像素數決定。~The size of the replayed image is set only by the pixel count of the target image.

units.anchor: GS 迭代迴圈與誤差曲線~GS iteration loop and error curve
units.title: Gerchberg–Saxton 演算法的收斂~Convergence of the Gerchberg–Saxton algorithm
units.mechanism: Gerchberg–Saxton 在兩個平面之間交替投影：在 SLM 面把振幅強制為均勻（只保留相位），在重建面把振幅強制為目標、保留計算得到的相位，每次迭代用一對 FFT 往返。因為每一步都是在集合上的投影，重建面的誤差單調不增，通常在 20 到 50 次迭代後進入停滯；連續影像的結果帶有隨機相位造成的散斑，點陣目標則可用加權 GS 把各點強度誤差回饋成權重，使均勻度逼近 99%。它對初始相位敏感，不同隨機種子得到不同的局部解。~Gerchberg–Saxton alternates projections between two planes: on the SLM plane the amplitude is forced to be uniform (keeping only phase), on the replay plane the amplitude is forced to the target while the computed phase is kept, and each iteration makes one round trip with a pair of FFTs. Because every step is a projection onto a set, the replay error is non-increasing and usually stagnates after 20 to 50 iterations; continuous images carry speckle from the random phase, while spot-array targets can use weighted GS, feeding each spot's intensity error back as a weight so uniformity approaches 99%. It is sensitive to the initial phase, and different random seeds land in different local solutions.
units.model: 1920×1080 = 2.07×10⁶ 點的 FFT 約需 5N·log₂N ≈ 5×2.07×10⁶×21 ≈ 2.2×10⁸ 次浮點運算，一次迭代兩個 FFT ≈ 4.4×10⁸，50 次迭代 ≈ 2.2×10¹⁰；GPU 有效 10¹² flop/s 時約 22 ms，CPU 10¹⁰ flop/s 時約 2.2 s。~An FFT of 1920×1080 = 2.07×10⁶ points costs about 5N·log₂N ≈ 5×2.07×10⁶×21 ≈ 2.2×10⁸ floating-point operations, one iteration with two FFTs ≈ 4.4×10⁸, and 50 iterations ≈ 2.2×10¹⁰; at an effective 10¹² flop/s on a GPU that is about 22 ms, and about 2.2 s at 10¹⁰ flop/s on a CPU.
units.verify: 記錄每次迭代重建面的均方根誤差與繞射效率，畫成曲線確認單調下降與停滯點；用 10 個不同隨機初始相位重跑，比較最終誤差的散佈；對點陣目標另外計算 (I_max − I_min)/(I_max + I_min) 的均勻度指標。~Log the replay-plane RMS error and diffraction efficiency at every iteration and plot them to confirm monotonic decrease and the stagnation point; rerun with 10 different random initial phases and compare the spread of final errors; for spot arrays also compute the uniformity metric (I_max − I_min)/(I_max + I_min).
units.failure: 迭代到第 10 次就停止以節省時間，重建影像的均方根誤差仍在 15%，點陣各點強度相差三成，光鑷實驗中部分粒子因陷阱太弱而逃脫。~Stopping at 10 iterations to save time leaves a 15% RMS error in the replay and a 30% spread among spot intensities; in an optical-tweezer experiment some particles escape because their traps are too weak.
units.misconception: GS 會收斂到全域最佳解，所以初始相位無關緊要。~GS converges to the global optimum, so the initial phase does not matter.

units.anchor: 相位階數與像素孔徑包絡~Phase levels and pixel-aperture envelope
units.title: 相位量化與像素包絡損失~Phase quantization and pixel-envelope losses
units.mechanism: 連續相位在元件上只能以有限階數表示：SLM 以 8 位元查找表給 256 級，靜態繞射元件則常只有 2 到 16 級。量化把部分能量推到共軛影像與其他繞射級，對類閃耀的相位結構效率約為 sinc²(1/M)。另一個與演算法無關的損失來自像素的有限孔徑：每個像素是寬度 a 的小孔，整個重建視窗被 sinc² 包絡調制，視窗邊緣的亮度明顯低於中心，必須在目標影像上預先以包絡的倒數補償。~A continuous phase can only be represented with a finite number of levels on hardware: an SLM gives 256 levels through an 8-bit lookup table, whereas static diffractive elements often have only 2 to 16. Quantization pushes part of the energy into the conjugate image and other orders, with efficiency about sinc²(1/M) for blaze-like phase structures. A second loss independent of the algorithm comes from the finite pixel aperture: each pixel is a small aperture of width a, so the whole replay window is modulated by a sinc² envelope and the window edge is noticeably dimmer than the centre, which must be pre-compensated by dividing the target by the envelope.
units.model: 量化效率 sinc²(1/M)：M = 2 為 40.5%、M = 4 為 81%、M = 8 為 95%、M = 16 為 98.7%、M = 256 為 99.995%。像素孔徑 a = 7.6 µm 時，視窗邊緣（空間頻率 1/(2p) = 62.5 mm⁻¹）的包絡 sinc²(a/(2p)) = sinc²(0.475) ≈ 0.45，距中心 2.5 mm 處（15.7 mm⁻¹）為 sinc²(0.119) ≈ 0.95。~Quantization efficiency sinc²(1/M) is 40.5% for M = 2, 81% for M = 4, 95% for M = 8, 98.7% for M = 16 and 99.995% for M = 256. With a pixel aperture a = 7.6 µm, the envelope at the window edge (spatial frequency 1/(2p) = 62.5 mm⁻¹) is sinc²(a/(2p)) = sinc²(0.475) ≈ 0.45, and at 2.5 mm off-centre (15.7 mm⁻¹) it is sinc²(0.119) ≈ 0.95.
units.verify: 把同一張連續相位圖分別量化成 2、4、8、256 級載入 SLM，用功率計量目標區域內的功率與總功率之比，與 sinc²(1/M) 比較；再載入均勻點陣，量各點強度對位置的曲線，擬合 sinc² 包絡並反推有效像素孔徑 a。~Quantize the same continuous phase map to 2, 4, 8 and 256 levels, load each onto the SLM and measure the ratio of power inside the target region to total power with a power meter, comparing with sinc²(1/M); then load a uniform spot array, measure spot intensity against position, fit a sinc² envelope and infer the effective pixel aperture a.
units.failure: 未補償包絡的全像顯示影像中央亮、四角暗 40%，設計者以為是演算法均勻度不足而反覆加權迭代，問題其實在硬體包絡。~A hologram without envelope compensation shows an image bright at the centre and 40% dark at the corners; the designer keeps adding weighted iterations for uniformity while the cause is the hardware envelope.
units.misconception: 256 級相位已是連續，所以 SLM 的全像沒有量化損失，也沒有邊緣變暗。~256 phase levels are effectively continuous, so SLM holograms suffer no quantization loss and no edge dimming.

units.anchor: 多階蝕刻相位元件與 SLM 查找表~Multilevel etched phase element and SLM lookup table
units.title: 從相位圖到元件：靜態與動態實現~From phase map to device: static and dynamic realizations
units.mechanism: 同一張設計相位圖可以動態載入 SLM，或固化成靜態的多階繞射元件。靜態元件以多次微影與蝕刻在熔融石英上做出 2ᵏ 階的台階，每階的蝕刻深度由波長與折射率差決定，深度誤差直接變成相位誤差並把能量洩漏到零階；它只對設計波長正確，但無像素間隙、無閃爍且能承受高功率。動態載入時相位圖要先經查找表轉成灰階，再疊加元件的波前修正圖與線性相位斜坡；任何波長改變都需要重算或重新縮放相位。~The same design phase map can be loaded dynamically onto an SLM or frozen into a static multilevel diffractive element. A static element is made by repeated lithography and etching of fused silica into 2ᵏ-level steps whose etch depth per level follows from wavelength and index contrast; depth error becomes phase error directly and leaks energy into the zeroth order. It is correct only at the design wavelength but has no pixel gaps, no flicker and tolerates high power. For dynamic loading the phase map is first converted to grey levels through the lookup table, then the device's wavefront-correction map and a linear phase ramp are added; any wavelength change requires recomputation or rescaling of the phase.
units.model: 熔融石英 n = 1.46、λ = 532 nm：一個 2π 的總深度 λ/(n − 1) = 532/0.46 ≈ 1157 nm，8 階每階 ≈ 145 nm；若總深度誤差 5%（相位 2π×1.05），一階效率 sinc²(0.05) ≈ 0.992，零階洩漏 sinc²(1.05) ≈ 0.2%；誤差 20% 時零階升到約 2.7%、一階降到 0.875。~Fused silica with n = 1.46 at λ = 532 nm: a full 2π needs a total depth of λ/(n − 1) = 532/0.46 ≈ 1157 nm, about 145 nm per level for 8 levels; a 5% total-depth error (phase 2π×1.05) gives a first-order efficiency of sinc²(0.05) ≈ 0.992 and a zeroth-order leak of sinc²(1.05) ≈ 0.2%; at 20% error the zeroth order rises to about 2.7% and the first order falls to 0.875.
units.verify: 靜態元件以白光干涉儀或台階儀量每階深度並換算相位誤差；動態載入則顯示相位圖後用功率計量零階殘留，若高於 3% 先檢查查找表與波長是否匹配，再檢查修正圖是否已套用。~For a static element measure each step depth with a white-light interferometer or stylus profiler and convert it to phase error; for dynamic loading measure residual zeroth order with a power meter after displaying the map, and if it exceeds 3% first check that the lookup table matches the wavelength, then that the correction map is applied.
units.failure: 為 532 nm 設計的 8 階石英元件用在 633 nm，總相位只剩 2π×0.84，一階效率降到約 0.92，零階洩漏約 2.5% 而出現中央亮點；元件本身並無製作缺陷。~An 8-level silica element designed for 532 nm used at 633 nm delivers only 2π×0.84 of phase; first-order efficiency falls to about 0.92 and a 2.5% zeroth-order leak forms a central bright spot although the element has no fabrication defect.
units.misconception: 設計相位圖與元件無關，換波長只要換光源就好。~The design phase map is device-independent, so changing wavelength only means changing the laser.

units.anchor: 重建面相機與閉環最佳化~Replay-plane camera and closed-loop optimization
units.title: 相機閉環校正與影像品質指標~Camera-in-the-loop calibration and image-quality metrics
units.mechanism: 模擬中的理想傅立葉轉換與真實光路之間有差異：SLM 相位非線性與邊緣電場、透鏡像差、光源的高斯強度分佈與對準誤差都會讓重建影像偏離設計。相機閉環把實際拍到的影像當成最佳化的回饋，透過可微分的傳播模型或學到的系統模型計算梯度並更新相位，使全像自動補償這些硬體缺陷。品質以峰值訊噪比、繞射效率與散斑對比三個指標共同描述，單一指標會互相掩蓋。~The ideal Fourier transform in simulation differs from the real optical train: SLM phase nonlinearity and fringing fields, lens aberrations, the Gaussian intensity profile of the source and alignment errors all pull the replayed image away from the design. Camera-in-the-loop uses the captured image as feedback, computes gradients through a differentiable propagation model or a learned system model and updates the phase, so the hologram compensates these hardware imperfections automatically. Quality is described jointly by peak signal-to-noise ratio, diffraction efficiency and speckle contrast, because any single metric can hide the others.
units.model: PSNR = 20·log₁₀(1/ε_rms)，ε_rms 為相對於滿刻度的均方根誤差：ε_rms = 3% 給 30.5 dB，10% 給 20 dB；閉環迭代 200 次、每次含一張相機曝光 20 ms 與兩次 FFT 約 1 ms，總時間約 4.2 s，主要耗在曝光而非計算。~PSNR = 20·log₁₀(1/ε_rms) with ε_rms the RMS error relative to full scale: ε_rms = 3% gives 30.5 dB and 10% gives 20 dB; 200 closed-loop iterations, each with a 20 ms camera exposure and about 1 ms for two FFTs, take about 4.2 s, dominated by exposure rather than computation.
units.verify: 先以相機拍攝開環 GS 的結果計算 PSNR 與效率，再執行閉環最佳化並記錄每次迭代的 PSNR；改善量應在前 50 次迭代內達到大半；最後用功率計核對效率沒有因為閉環而下降超過 5%，並量一塊均勻區的散斑對比。~Capture the open-loop GS result with the camera to compute PSNR and efficiency, then run closed-loop optimization while logging PSNR per iteration; most of the gain should arrive within the first 50 iterations; finally verify with a power meter that efficiency has not fallen by more than 5% through the loop, and measure speckle contrast on a uniform patch.
units.failure: 相機曝光飽和時梯度失真，閉環把亮區壓暗以「降低誤差」，整體效率掉到五成而 PSNR 看似提升；驗收時影像偏暗才發現迴圈在錯誤的量測上收斂。~With the camera saturated the gradients are distorted; the loop dims bright regions to reduce error, overall efficiency falls to half while PSNR seems to improve, and only the dim image at acceptance reveals that the loop converged on a wrong measurement.
units.misconception: PSNR 越高代表全像在所有方面都越好。~A higher PSNR means the hologram is better in every respect.

units.anchor: 散斑對比、零階與波長漂移~Speckle contrast, zeroth order and wavelength drift
units.title: 散斑、零階與波長的誤差預算~Speckle, zeroth-order and wavelength error budget
units.mechanism: 相位全像的三個系統性誤差各有來源：連續影像的隨機相位解在相鄰像元之間干涉，產生對比接近 1 的散斑，時間多工 K 張獨立全像可把對比降到 1/√K，但受 SLM 幀率限制；零階來自未調制光與查找表誤差，固定落在視窗中心；波長漂移則按比例縮放整個重建面，使邊緣的點偏離設計位置。預算表把三者換算成同一組影像指標後，才能判斷是改演算法、改硬體還是改光源。~Three systematic errors of phase holograms have distinct origins: the random-phase solution for a continuous image interferes between neighbouring replay cells and produces speckle with contrast near 1, which time-multiplexing K independent holograms reduces to 1/√K within the limit of SLM frame rate; the zeroth order comes from unmodulated light and lookup-table error and stays fixed at the window centre; wavelength drift scales the whole replay plane proportionally so that edge points leave their design positions. Only after the budget converts all three into the same image metrics can one decide whether to change the algorithm, the hardware or the source.
units.model: K = 8 張時間多工全像的散斑對比 1/√8 ≈ 0.35，K = 16 為 0.25，60 Hz 影像下 K = 16 需要 960 Hz 的 SLM，超出液晶元件能力。零階洩漏 2% 集中在 10 µm 像元內，其亮度約為均攤在 10×10 mm 影像上 98% 能量的 2×10⁴ 倍。波長漂移 0.5 nm（0.094%）使距中心 10 mm 的點移動 9.4 µm，約一個像元。~Time-multiplexing K = 8 holograms gives a speckle contrast of 1/√8 ≈ 0.35, and K = 16 gives 0.25, but at 60 Hz video K = 16 needs a 960 Hz SLM, beyond liquid-crystal devices. A 2% zeroth-order leak concentrated in one 10 µm cell is about 2×10⁴ times brighter than the 98% spread over a 10×10 mm image. A 0.5 nm wavelength drift (0.094%) moves a point 10 mm off-centre by 9.4 µm, about one replay cell.
units.verify: 拍攝均勻目標區並計算強度標準差除以平均值得到散斑對比，與 1/√K 比較；以功率計量零階與總功率的比值；用波長計監測光源並在 1 小時內重複拍攝點陣，追蹤邊緣點位移是否與 Δλ/λ 成正比。~Image a uniform target region and compute the standard deviation over the mean as speckle contrast, comparing with 1/√K; measure the ratio of zeroth-order to total power with a power meter; monitor the source with a wavemeter and re-image a spot array over one hour to check that edge-point displacement scales with Δλ/λ.
units.failure: 雷射二極體未穩溫，波長在 2 nm 內游移，10×10 點陣的外圈陷阱來回移動 40 µm，光鑷中的細胞被拖動；誤判為機械振動而更換隔振台卻無效。~An unstabilized diode laser wanders by 2 nm, the outer traps of a 10×10 array move back and forth by 40 µm and cells in the tweezers are dragged; the fault is misread as mechanical vibration and a new isolation table changes nothing.
units.misconception: 散斑只是光源的問題，與全像演算法無關。~Speckle is only a light-source problem, unrelated to the hologram algorithm.

units.anchor: 角譜傳播與近眼眼盒~Angular-spectrum propagation and near-eye eyebox
units.title: 多平面全像與近眼顯示的幾何限制~Multi-plane holograms and near-eye display geometry
units.mechanism: 全像顯示不經傅立葉透鏡而直接以菲涅耳或角譜傳播到不同距離的平面，可同時在多個深度成像並提供真實的聚焦線索；每個深度平面在最佳化中以各自的傳播核計算，彩色則以三個波長分時逐一計算。但 SLM 的像素週期限制最大繞射角，因而限制眼盒寬度；SLM 的實際尺寸限制視角。兩者互相拉扯：小像素擴大繞射角卻縮小面板，所以近眼全像顯示的規格由像素週期與面板尺寸共同鎖定。~A holographic display skips the Fourier lens and propagates directly by Fresnel or angular-spectrum methods to planes at different distances, forming images at several depths at once with true focus cues; each depth plane is computed with its own propagation kernel in the optimization, and colour is handled with three wavelengths in time sequence. The SLM pixel pitch, however, limits the maximum diffraction angle and therefore the eyebox width, while the physical SLM size limits the field of view. The two pull against each other: smaller pixels widen the diffraction angle but shrink the panel, so near-eye holographic display specifications are locked jointly by pitch and panel size.
units.model: 最大繞射半角 θ_max = asin(λ/(2p))：p = 8 µm、532 nm 時 1.9°，距離 z = 50 mm 的眼盒 ≈ 2z·tanθ_max ≈ 3.3 mm；p = 3.74 µm 時 4.1°、眼盒 7.2 mm。面板寬 15.4 mm 在 50 mm 處的視角 2·atan(7.7/50) ≈ 17.5°。角譜法每個深度平面需兩個 FFT，三色五層共 30 個 FFT。~The maximum diffraction half-angle θ_max = asin(λ/(2p)) is 1.9° for p = 8 µm at 532 nm, giving an eyebox ≈ 2z·tanθ_max ≈ 3.3 mm at z = 50 mm; p = 3.74 µm gives 4.1° and 7.2 mm. A 15.4 mm panel at 50 mm spans a field of 2·atan(7.7/50) ≈ 17.5°. The angular-spectrum method needs two FFTs per depth plane, so three colours and five planes need 30 FFTs.
units.verify: 以相機加 50 mm 焦距鏡頭模擬眼睛，在眼盒範圍內以 0.5 mm 步進平移相機，記錄影像亮度降到一半的位置以量眼盒；再改變相機對焦距離，確認多平面全像中各深度的目標在對應距離清晰、其他距離模糊。~Emulate the eye with a camera and a 50 mm lens, translate it across the eyebox in 0.5 mm steps and record where image brightness halves to measure the eyebox; then change the camera focus distance to confirm that each depth target of the multi-plane hologram is sharp at its own distance and blurred elsewhere.
units.failure: 用 8 µm 像素的 SLM 做近眼顯示，眼盒只有 3 mm，使用者眼球微動影像就消失，被誤以為是追蹤系統延遲；根本限制在像素週期，軟體無法補救。~A near-eye display built on an 8 µm SLM has only a 3 mm eyebox, and the image vanishes with slight eye movement, blamed on tracking latency; the limit is the pixel pitch and no software can recover it.
units.misconception: 全像顯示的視角可以靠演算法無限放大。~The field of view of a holographic display can be enlarged without limit by the algorithm.

units.anchor: 全像資料包與回歸測試~Hologram data package and regression tests
units.title: 驗收指標與工程交接~Acceptance metrics and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 交接的對象不只是相位圖，而是一個可重現的資料包：相位圖與其版本、波長、像素週期、焦距、查找表識別碼、波前修正圖、包絡補償係數，以及在指定硬體上量得的效率、PSNR、均勻度、零階與散斑對比。驗收以理論上限的比例訂門檻，使不同系統可以比較；回歸測試在固定時間間隔重跑同一組全像，追蹤硬體漂移。光鑷等應用還要把每個陷阱的功率預算一併列出。~What is handed over is not only a phase map but a reproducible data package: the map with its version, wavelength, pixel pitch, focal length, lookup-table identifier, wavefront-correction map, envelope-compensation coefficients, and the efficiency, PSNR, uniformity, zeroth order and speckle contrast measured on the specified hardware. Acceptance thresholds are set as fractions of theoretical limits so that different systems can be compared, and regression tests rerun the same hologram set at fixed intervals to track hardware drift. Applications such as optical tweezers also list the per-trap power budget.
units.model: 10×10 點陣：加權 GS 理論效率 0.90、均勻度 0.99；實測效率 0.85（比例 0.94 ≥ 0.90 門檻）、均勻度 0.96（≥ 0.95）。功率預算：雷射 160 mW × 效率 0.85 × 光路穿透 0.50 ≈ 68 mW，每個陷阱 0.68 mW；零階 ≤ 3%、PSNR ≥ 28 dB、一週後回歸測試效率變化 ≤ 5%。~For a 10×10 spot array: weighted-GS theoretical efficiency 0.90 and uniformity 0.99; measured efficiency 0.85 (ratio 0.94 ≥ the 0.90 threshold) and uniformity 0.96 (≥ 0.95). Power budget: 160 mW laser × 0.85 efficiency × 0.50 train transmission ≈ 68 mW, i.e. 0.68 mW per trap; zeroth order ≤ 3%, PSNR ≥ 28 dB, and regression after one week must show ≤ 5% efficiency change.
units.verify: 依資料包重建同一全像，量效率、均勻度、零階與 PSNR 並與包內數值比對，差異超過門檻即判定硬體漂移並重做查找表或修正圖；把量測腳本與相機設定一併納入資料包，使下一位工程師能在一小時內重現。~Rebuild the same hologram from the package, measure efficiency, uniformity, zeroth order and PSNR and compare with the packaged values; a difference beyond threshold flags hardware drift and triggers a new lookup table or correction map; include the measurement scripts and camera settings in the package so the next engineer can reproduce it within an hour.
units.failure: 只交付相位圖的 PNG 檔而沒有波長與查找表資訊，接手者在 633 nm 系統載入 532 nm 的圖，影像尺寸放大 19% 並出現強零階，花數天才發現不是相位圖損壞。~Delivering only a PNG of the phase map without wavelength or lookup-table information leads the next user to load a 532 nm map on a 633 nm system; the image scales up by 19% with a strong zeroth order, and days pass before the cause is traced to the missing metadata rather than a corrupted map.
units.misconception: 相位圖是純數學結果，在任何系統上都會給出相同影像。~A phase map is a pure mathematical result and gives the same image on any system.

example: 設計練習：用 1920×1080、p = 8 µm 的相位型 SLM、λ = 532 nm、f = 300 mm 產生 10×10、間距 0.5 mm 的光鑷點陣。視窗寬 λf/p ≈ 19.95 mm，像元 10.4 µm；點陣外圈距中心 2.5 mm 對應 15.7 mm⁻¹，即 8 像素週期光柵。像素孔徑 7.6 µm 的包絡在 2.5 mm 處為 sinc²(0.119) ≈ 0.95，故外圈目標預先放大 1/0.95。GS 每次迭代兩個 2.07 Mpixel FFT ≈ 4.4×10⁸ flop，50 次 ≈ 2.2×10¹⁰ flop，GPU 約 22 ms。8 位元量化效率 99.995%，可忽略。加權 GS 理論效率 0.90、均勻度 0.99；實測 0.85 與 0.96 皆過門檻。功率：160 mW × 0.85 × 0.50 ≈ 68 mW，每陷阱 0.68 mW。若雷射漂移 0.5 nm，外圈點移動 2.5 mm × 0.094% ≈ 2.4 µm，小於一個像元，可接受；漂移 2 nm 則移動 9.4 µm，需穩溫。數值為教學假設。~Design exercise: generate a 10×10 optical-tweezer spot array with 0.5 mm spacing using a 1920×1080, p = 8 µm phase-only SLM at λ = 532 nm with f = 300 mm. The window is λf/p ≈ 19.95 mm wide with 10.4 µm cells; the outer spots 2.5 mm off-centre correspond to 15.7 mm⁻¹, an 8-pixel-period grating. The envelope of a 7.6 µm pixel aperture at 2.5 mm is sinc²(0.119) ≈ 0.95, so the outer targets are pre-scaled by 1/0.95. Each GS iteration with two 2.07 Mpixel FFTs costs ≈ 4.4×10⁸ flop, 50 iterations ≈ 2.2×10¹⁰ flop, about 22 ms on a GPU. The 8-bit quantization efficiency of 99.995% is negligible. Weighted GS predicts 0.90 efficiency and 0.99 uniformity; measured 0.85 and 0.96 both pass. Power: 160 mW × 0.85 × 0.50 ≈ 68 mW, 0.68 mW per trap. A 0.5 nm laser drift moves the outer spots by 2.5 mm × 0.094% ≈ 2.4 µm, under one cell and acceptable; a 2 nm drift moves them 9.4 µm and demands temperature stabilization. Values are teaching assumptions.
history: 1966 至 1967 年 IBM 的 Lohmann 與 Brown 以繞路相位法用繪圖機與縮小攝影做出第一批計算全像；1972 年劍橋 Cavendish 實驗室的 Gerchberg 與 Saxton 為電子顯微相位還原提出交替投影演算法，1982 年 Fienup 將其推廣為誤差縮減與混合輸入輸出法，1988 年 Wyrowski 與 Bryngdahl 的迭代傅立葉轉換演算法使純相位繞射元件設計成熟。2000 年前後液晶 SLM 使全像光鑷與動態光束整形普及；2019 至 2020 年 Wirtinger 全像與史丹佛的 Neural Holography 引入梯度下降、相機閉環與神經網路，把相位全像推向即時彩色顯示。~In 1966 and 1967 Lohmann and Brown at IBM made the first computer-generated holograms with the detour-phase method using a plotter and photographic reduction; in 1972 Gerchberg and Saxton at the Cavendish Laboratory in Cambridge proposed the alternating-projection algorithm for electron-microscope phase retrieval, Fienup generalized it in 1982 into error-reduction and hybrid input-output methods, and the iterative Fourier-transform algorithm of Wyrowski and Bryngdahl in 1988 matured phase-only diffractive design. Around 2000 liquid-crystal SLMs spread holographic optical tweezers and dynamic beam shaping; in 2019 and 2020 Wirtinger holography and Stanford's Neural Holography brought gradient descent, camera-in-the-loop calibration and neural networks, pushing phase-only holography toward real-time colour displays.
